description: Builds Redfish URIs locally and sends them to iLO to get information back.

parameters.name: auth_token
parameters.description: Security token for authenticating to iLO.

parameters.name: ca_path
parameters.description: PEM formatted file that contains a CA certificate to be used for validation. Only used if validate_certs=true.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: List of categories to execute on iLO.

parameters.name: ciphers
parameters.description: TLS/SSL Ciphers to use for the request. When a list is provided, all ciphers are joined in order with :. See the OpenSSL Cipher List Format for more details. The available ciphers is dependent on the Python and OpenSSL/LibreSSL versions.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: List of commands to execute on iLO.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Timeout in seconds for HTTP requests to iLO. Default: 10

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: If false, TLS/SSL certificates are not validated. Set this to true to enable certificate checking. Should be used together with ca_path. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
- name: Get iLO Sessions
  community.general.ilo_redfish_info:
    category: Sessions
    command: GetiLOSessions
    baseuri: "{{ baseuri }}"
    username: "{{ username }}"
    password: "{{ password }}"
  register: result_sessions

return_values.name: GetiLOSessions
return_values.description: Returns the iLO session msg and whether the function executed successfully. Returned: success

return_values.name: msg
return_values.description: Information of all active iLO sessions. Returned: success

return_values.name: Description
return_values.description: Provides a description of the resource. Returned: success

return_values.name: Name
return_values.description: The name of the resource. Returned: success

return_values.name: UserName
return_values.description: Name to use to log in to the management processor. Returned: success

return_values.name: ret
return_values.description: Check variable to see if the information was successfully retrieved. Returned: success
